svg.text: Raised cut, five heights and thicknesses
Red ticks mark the edges of the cut on the 200 px word.
cut moved up, same thickness as now
top of the cut = bottom of the t crossbar, 10 units
starts under the crossbar, exactly as thick as it
top = bottom of the r arm, so the r keeps its whole arm
D Under the r arm, wide
same line, thicker, so the gap holds at 24 px
E Hairline at the h counter
top = top of the h counter, very thin
